scope: Offline staged-controller verification only. Real temporary Unix datagram sockets, synthetic child processes, fake radio adapters and temporary session state; no live rfkill, WPA, network, service or package mutation.

demonstrated_old_failures: A full Unix datagram send queue blocked the initial WPA request before its receive deadline began.
A rejected ATTACH left the private Unix client socket path behind.
Deprecated rfkill state=2 rejected a valid simultaneous soft and hard block and misreported soft_blocked.
An unreadable adapter soft attribute could not be distinguished by the old state-only verification.
A real scan completion delivered before its command reply was discarded, causing a false timeout.

reproductions.name: full_wpa_send_queue
reproductions.result: A real full Unix datagram queue times out without the fake peer draining it.

reproductions.name: rejected_attach_cleanup
reproductions.result: The temporary client socket is closed and unlinked after an actual FAIL reply.

reproductions.name: dhcp_style_hook_group
reproductions.result: A real sleeping command and its hook child are killed as one process group; the leader is reaped.

reproductions.name: exited_leader_with_open_stdout
reproductions.result: The leader exits 0 while a hook holds stdout open. communicate retains returncode=None until the pipe timeout; cleanup kills the group, then reaps leader status 0. The existing early-return cleanup needed no further change.

reproductions.name: bounded_lock
reproductions.result: A real contended advisory lock reaches its acquisition deadline.

reproductions.name: absolute_deadline
reproductions.result: An actual SIGALRM interrupts the transaction and restores the previous alarm handler/timer.

reproductions.name: expired_connect_fail_off
reproductions.result: An actual deadline interrupt during a fake connection reblocks both fake radio classes, removes session state and only then releases the lock.

reproductions.name: soft_and_hard_matrix
reproductions.result: Fake sysfs adapters cover all four soft/hard combinations, reject hard-only blocking as a persistent software block, and reject missing/invalid soft state.

reproductions.name: scan_event_order_and_identity
reproductions.result: Real Unix datagrams cover events before/after the reply, queued old events, delayed old IDs, substring/duplicate-ID traps, numeric ID bounds, bounded event flooding and nonblocking consumption. SCAN use_id=1 completion requires an exact ID match.

deadline_scope: 45 seconds bounds the active transaction. Lock acquisition has a separate 60-second budget; bounded process cleanup and fail-off attempts occur after transaction expiry and can add wall-clock time. Descendants that deliberately create a separate process session are outside the command group.
unchanged: Healthy trusted associations remain valid until off or disconnect.
not_verified: Live wireless association, scan, sleep/resume or reboot; these require deployment verification.
wpa_source_basis: Official vendor-import WPA2.11 source plus installed Alpine2.11 version and compiled scan-ID strings. No exact upstream tar archive verification or live scan claimed.
